answer: Propose one AI vote/key/day on a glacier atlas after a million-node hash trellis calculation. Each node hashes key, day, index and parent outputs. Validators recompute; mismatches or duplicate key/day claims get no vote. Hardware is reusable capital; computation is recurring expense, not locked stake. Verifiers bear the same work, and wealth buys aliases. Assuming no hash shortcuts, ten keys need ten million node hashes/day; sharing hosts or running in parallel cannot reuse those hashes.
